text:
Alex: Quick proposal — unify the rerank endpoint to accept per-candidate numeric scores + an optional model_affinity header. Need opinions on scoring format, quota accounting, and dashboard telemetry. TL;DR: keep response small for mobile clients but include minimal provenance for debugging. Example shape below. Thoughts?

Maria: +1 on provenance, but prefer normalized scores (0-1). Don’t force logits in the public API — different models have different scales. If teams need raw logits, put them in an optional score_meta.

Jamal: Important: decide cost model. Charging per-token will explode for big candidate lists. Propose per-candidate unit: 1 score-unit per candidate (with multiplier for high-accuracy models). Also hard cap per-request for hosted tier.

Ryan: Routing note — we should let routing policy pick best-effort cheap model for non-SLA routes and premium model for dedicated customers. model_affinity can be a hint. Console should let customers pin routing policy by route.

Maria: Telemetry wishlist: score_distribution histogram, candidate_count, topk_entropy, model_version tag. These should be first-class dashboard widgets and usable in alerts.

Alex: Minimal example response we discussed:

```json
{
  "candidates": [
    {"id":"c1","score":0.82,"score_meta":{"model":"redwood-v2-small","raw_logit":10.2}},
    {"id":"c2","score":0.41}
  ],
  "model_affinity":"high-precision",
  "warnings": []
}
```

Alex: Notes: - score is normalized 0-1; - score_meta optional and opt-in to keep payloads small; - keep candidate objects tiny (id + score) by default.

Jamal: Payload size is key. For huge lists maybe we should offer a compressed mode or cursor-based paging. But prefer limits: hosted default max_candidates=100, dedicated up to 500 with quota increase. Timeouts also matter (hosted 3s, dedicated 10s).

Ryan: Agreed on limits. Also need per-minute spike protection so large batch jobs can't blow past quotas. Maybe a per-route token bucket in front of rerank.

Maria: Rollout UX: canary by tracking score-drift on a golden eval set. Console should surface drift % and allow auto-fallback to previous model if drift exceeds threshold. Also show top failing prompts.

Jamal: Backwards compatibility: older clients may expect a plain list of ids. We should support a compatibility mode where only ids are returned if client requests `format=ids_only`.

Alex: Good point. Also add an explicit `score_unit` field in response ("0-1") to avoid ambiguity.

Maria: Proposed metric names for infra: `rerank.candidate_count`, `rerank.score.p50`, `rerank.score.entropy`, `rerank.model.version` and `rerank.request.latency_ms`. These should show up in the per-route dashboard.

Alex: Action items: draft RFC capturing shape, limits, telemetry, routing hints, and rollout plan. Owners: Jamal (quotas/limits), Maria (telemetry/dashboard), Ryan (routing/policy), Alex (API shape + RFC coordinator). I'll open the PR today. Deadline EOD Friday for a first pass.

DeployBot: RFC scaffold created at /docs/rfcs/1854321789-rerank-unified-shape.md :rocket:

Jamal: :thumbsup: One more ask — add a small `score_unit` enum and a `provenance` tag in score_meta (e.g., "model:v2-small").

Maria: Also include sample dashboard wireframes in the RFC (score histogram + drift timeline + top-10 prompt table).

Alex: Thanks all. If no objections I'll start the PR and tag owners. If you want different defaults for Dedicated vs Hosted put them in a short note in the RFC.

Ryan: No objections. Will add routing policy sketches to the PR.

Maria: Will mock dashboards this afternoon.

Jamal: I'll draft the quota matrix and example billing quanta.

Alex: Great. Marking this thread closed for now.
